descricao_original: The thin limb of the loop of Henle is lined by a simple squamous epithelium whose thickness is usually greater than that of a capillary. The ascending thick limb is lined with a simple cuboidal epithelium whose nuclei are irregularly arranged around and bulge into the lumen. 400x
